content: bioRxiv 2024.09.16.611953 / F1000Research 15:410 (Cabrera et al., published March 2026) is titled 'Establishment of an optimized and automated workflow for whole brain probing of neuronal activity.' It describes a QuPath+ABBA pipeline combining cFos IHC with cFos-driven Cre-dependent tdTomato (TRAP2) to compare neural circuits across time/tasks, automating cell detection, cFos vs cFos/tdTomato classification, and whole-brain registration. Full-text (bioRxiv and F1000Research) returned HTTP 403 in this session (consistent with a prior research session's finding) so exact target-range/parameter numbers could not be directly quoted; only abstract-level description confirmed via search snippets and the authors' public GitHub scripts repo (which documents no specific numeric thresholds either -- 'fixed parameters (cell diameter, sphericity...)' unspecified).
